title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer of 380 m must be clearly stated.

title: Angular Resolution
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of angular resolution using the formula lambda/D must be correctly applied.

title: Distance Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The multiplication of the angular resolution by the distance to the moon must be correctly performed.

title: Wavelength Usage
description: Optional Criteria: The wavelength of light used in the calculations should be correctly identified and applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any mistakes in unit conversions or maintaining consistent units throughout the calculations will lead to a deduction.
